outcome: Association between tooth-brushing habits and caries
Association between mode of delivery and caries
cohort: 336 children who underwent oral examinations at ages 2, 3, and 5 years
finding: Tooth brushing less than twice daily and difficulties with tooth brushing during the first 3 years of life were significantly associated with caries prevalence at age 5, while mode of delivery was not significantly associated.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between tooth brushing habits and mode of delivery.
